scope: reumlab repository only; local static out and source code
artifactStage: first out before final merged content build
limitations: These passing results describe the first out, not the final content build or deployed site.
The scripts' unsupported-claim checks use known patterns and do not establish factual evidence for customer achievements.
HTTP response status, Netlify form storage, email delivery, search-engine indexing and analytics ingestion were not verified.
No real form submissions, browser operations or external account changes were made.

findings: Both handlers require res.ok before success UI and conversion events.
The static form lacked a timeout and could leave the button locked on a stalled request.
The React form called fbq without isolation, so a pixel exception could change an already accepted submission into an error UI.
changes: Static form aborts after 20 seconds, preserves user input and unlocks the button.
Timeout text says the request may already have been received and asks users to confirm before resubmitting.
React pixel exceptions no longer affect submission success.

tests.method: Execute real legacy and React submit handlers with mock DOM and mock fetch; exercise HTTP success, HTTP error, network rejection, timeout, duplicate click, pixel failure and input preservation.
Existing form field, routing and privacy regressions.

sourceFormReview.serverAcceptanceStatus: Not tested against Netlify; mock HTTP success only. A 2xx code alone is not independent evidence that a production submission was stored.
